sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 139)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network, Van Johnson starring in Phil Stong's *State Fair* hosted by James Hilton for Hallmark Cards, Roy Rogers and Dale Evans rounding up rustlers for Dodge Dealers, Arthur Treacher taking Hedda Hopper on a chaotic Beverly Hills bus tour on CBS *Forecast*, Ben Bentley breaking down Muhammad Ali on *Bob Elson Interviews*, John Steinbeck's *The Moon Is Down* on *Hollywood Radio Theater*, and Bruce Foote singing Noël Coward's *Conversation Piece* on *The Chicago Theater of the Air* (1941–1978):
